description: Traverse links touching one tool by id. A tool is an MCP-exposed capability agents can invoke. It governs action surface by keeping work on declared tools instead of ad-hoc side channels.

id.description: Object id whose links to traverse.

kind.description: Optional link kind filter — only edges of this kind are returned.

name: qf_execution_environment_get
description: Fetch one execution_environment by id. An execution_environment identifies where a run actually executes. It governs reproducibility by separating runtime substrate from run intent.

id.description: Object id to fetch.

name: qf_execution_environment_query
description: List execution_environment rows with optional filters. An execution_environment identifies where a run actually executes. It governs reproducibility by separating runtime substrate from run intent.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return. Omit for default 100; pass null for no limit.

offset.description: Rows to skip before returning results.

order.description: Sort order on created_at. Defaults to desc when omitted.

kind.description: Equality filter on kind. Execution substrate category used by runs linked through executes_in. Choose the narrowest accurate kind so failure domains stay interpretable.

label.description: Equality filter on label. Operator-facing name for this environment instance. Keep labels specific enough to distinguish local and remote contexts at a glance.

name: qf_execution_environment_links
description: Traverse links touching one execution_environment by id. An execution_environment identifies where a run actually executes. It governs reproducibility by separating runtime substrate from run intent.

id.description: Object id whose links to traverse.

kind.description: Optional link kind filter — only edges of this kind are returned.

name: qf_connection_get
description: Fetch one connection by id. A connection is a typed edge between canvas tiles. It governs projection wiring only and must never become an independent truth store.

id.description: Object id to fetch.

name: qf_connection_query
description: List connection rows with optional filters. A connection is a typed edge between canvas tiles. It governs projection wiring only and must never become an independent truth store.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return. Omit for default 100; pass null for no limit.

offset.description: Rows to skip before returning results.

order.description: Sort order on created_at. Defaults to desc when omitted.

kind.description: Equality filter on kind. Connection category such as data, control, or view. Use a constrained vocabulary in higher layers so traversal semantics stay predictable.

from_ref.description: Equality filter on from_ref. Source tile or object identifier for this connection. It should reference existing canvas entities rather than inferred placeholders.

to_ref.description: Equality filter on to_ref. Target tile or object identifier for this connection. Keep directional intent explicit so reverse traversals are computed, not guessed.

name: qf_connection_links
description: Traverse links touching one connection by id. A connection is a typed edge between canvas tiles. It governs projection wiring only and must never become an independent truth store.

id.description: Object id whose links to traverse.

kind.description: Optional link kind filter — only edges of this kind are returned.

name: qf_create_hypothesis
description: Open a new research hypothesis with claim, success criteria, and optional sources.

success_criteria.description: How an evaluation would support this claim.

name: qf_register_dataset_version
description: Register a new content-hashed, point-in-time dataset version in the Kernel.

kind.description: Dataset kind being registered.

artifact_id.description: Existing immutable result_set Artifact that contains qf.dataset.v1 bytes.

content_hash.description: Hash of the underlying dataset bytes; must equal the Artifact identity.

name: qf_create_run
description: Enqueue a new run in queued status with full invocation params. Rejectable when params are invalid.

run_id.description: Id for the new run row (caller-supplied, adopted).

kind.description: Execution mode for this run.

params.description: Full invocation arguments captured at launch.

trace_id.description: Root span id; defaults to ctx.trace_id when omitted.

name: qf_execute_deterministic_run
description: Execute one canonical strategy specification against one immutable Dataset. The Kernel owns the execution version, result bytes, content hash, and complete uses/executes_in/produces lineage; a claimed repeat is rejected unless its manifest and result hash match.

run_id.description: Caller-selected id for this execution record.

dataset_id.description: Existing immutable Dataset registered through register_dataset_version.

strategy_spec.description: Declarative qf.strategy.v1 specification. R11a supports deterministic descending ranking by one numeric observation field.

params.description: Exact execution parameters. R11a supports limit and optional minimum_score.

repeat_of_run_id.description: Optional succeeded run claimed as an identical replay. The Kernel rejects any manifest or result mismatch.

name: qf_create_mission
description: Register a standing research mission with name and objective.

mission_id.description: Optional id; Kernel mints a UUID when omitted.

name: qf_create_ticket
description: Record a strategy-proposed ticket starting pending. Does not accept a grade; use observe_ticket for externally observed slips.

kind.description: Single or parlay wager.

name: qf_observe_ticket
description: Ingest an externally observed ticket at its settlement grade. Writes an observation event, never a synthetic transition.

kind.description: Single or parlay wager.

grade.description: Observed settlement grade at ingestion; terminal grades allowed.

name: qf_start_run
description: Start a queued run (queued → running). Rejectable if the transition is illegal.

run_id.description: Id of the queued run to start.

name: qf_cancel_run
description: Cancel a running run (running → cancelled).

run_id.description: Id of the running run to cancel.

name: qf_complete_run
description: Mark a running run as succeeded (running → succeeded).

run_id.description: Id of the running run to complete.

name: qf_fail_run
description: Mark a running run as failed (running → failed).

run_id.description: Id of the running run that failed.

name: qf_grade_ticket
description: Grade a pending ticket to win|loss|push|void after result settlement.

name: qf_start_event
description: Move a scheduled event to live (scheduled → live).

name: qf_settle_event
description: Settle a live event (live → settled).

name: qf_void_event
description: Void a scheduled event that will not be contested (scheduled → void).

name: qf_register_venue
description: Register one trusted venue identity from an existing source Artifact. Operator-only provenance is required and retries must preserve the original venue rather than silently updating it.

venue_id.description: This field is the stable Kernel identity for the venue. Reuse it only when all stored venue fields and provenance are an exact replay.

kind.description: This field identifies the venue class that governs listing and settlement behavior. Add new classes by order so downstream assumptions remain explicit.

name.description: This field stores the operator-visible venue name, such as Bovada. Keep names stable so external references can be re-imported idempotently.

source_artifact_id.description: This field identifies the existing Artifact that preserves the observed venue source. The Kernel rejects a reference that is not already present.

observed_at.description: This field records when the venue was observed in ISO-8601 UTC. Preserve it as provenance and never substitute ingest time.

name: qf_schedule_market_event
description: Schedule one trusted market event from an existing source Artifact. Operator-only provenance is required and creation always writes scheduled state without accepting a caller-supplied status.

market_event_id.description: This field is the stable Kernel identity for the market event. Reuse it only when all stored event fields and provenance are an exact replay.

sport.description: This field names the sport domain for the occurrence. Use it to interpret market vocabularies while keeping shared instrument structure in one type.

starts_at.description: This field records the scheduled start timestamp in ISO-8601 UTC. Do not use data timestamped after this moment for pre-event decisions.

competition.description: This field stores the competition context such as league, card, or tournament round. Keep the value operator-legible so slips and reports can be reconciled without external decoding.

source_artifact_id.description: This field identifies the existing Artifact that preserves the observed event source. The Kernel rejects a reference that is not already present.

observed_at.description: This field records when the event was observed in ISO-8601 UTC. Preserve it as provenance and never substitute ingest time.

name: qf_ingest_market_batch
description: Ingest one provenance-bound batch of instrument and quote rows through the trusted market pipeline. The Kernel must validate the whole batch and commit its rows, derived quote links, and evidence events atomically.

source_artifact_id.description: This field identifies the existing Artifact that preserves the captured source. The Kernel rejects a batch whose source evidence does not exist.

observed_at.description: This field records the ISO-8601 observation timestamp shared by the batch. Preserve it as provenance rather than substituting ingest time.

venue_id.description: This field identifies the existing venue for every instrument in the batch. The Kernel derives one lists edge from this identity and never infers venue from free-form market fields.

id.description: This field is the stable Kernel identity for the instrument row. Retries must reuse it only for byte-equivalent market state and provenance.

market_event_id.description: This field names the existing market event for the instrument, or null when no bounded event dependency is declared. The Kernel derives offered_on only from this identity.

kind.description: This field identifies the instrument family needed to interpret pricing semantics. Extend the enum by order rather than cloning new object types per category.

params.description: This field stores kind-specific parameters such as lines, methods, rounds, or handicaps. Keep it machine-readable and deterministic so equivalent instruments compare cleanly.

sides.description: This field lists the named outcomes offered for the instrument, such as ["Jones","Miocic"] or ["over","under"]. Preserve provider wording so grading and reconciliation can be traced exactly.

anyOf.description: This field groups instruments with known dependent outcomes. Leave it null only when no declared dependence key is available.

instruments.description: This field carries strict instrument rows for atomic ingestion. Supply an empty array only when the batch contains at least one quote row.

id.description: This field is the stable Kernel identity for the quote row. Retries must reuse it only for byte-equivalent quote state and provenance.

instrument_id.description: This field identifies the instrument priced by the quote. The Kernel derives exactly one quotes link from this identity.

book.description: This field identifies the source venue or book that published the prices. Use stable lowercase identifiers so cross-source joins remain deterministic.

data_ref.description: This field points to the content-addressed segment containing timestamped quotes. Treat it as immutable evidence for replay and audit.

coverage.description: This field summarizes temporal and count coverage for the referenced quote data. Use it as a sufficiency hint, not as a replacement for inspecting underlying rows.

quotes.description: This field carries strict quote rows and their instrument identities for derived links. Supply an empty array only when the batch contains at least one instrument row.

name: qf_register_agent_definition
description: Register a Dock profile in the Kernel registry (id = name). Duplicate names are rejected; operator-only because it controls package_ref and runtime_profile.

name.description: Unique profile name; becomes the row id.

role.description: Role summary (researcher, critic, backtester, ingestion) for routing and prompts.

package_ref.description: Runtime package this profile launches — the reusable executable half of the row.

anyOf.description: Optional runtime adapter profile selector. Omission stores null; empty or whitespace-only input is rejected.
Artifact or prompt id that defines this profile's instructions.

capability_groups.description: Capability groups this profile may invoke through the ontology gateway. Grant groups only — never individual tool names.

display_name.description: Founder-facing Dock role label. Production profiles use exactly Market Researcher, Orchestrator, or Critic.

name: qf_create_agent_session
description: Create an agent_session by adopting a guest-minted session_id (Kernel never mints). Requires agent_definition_id and atomically links spawned_from; label is presentation-only.

session_id.description: Guest-minted ACP session id — adopted as the Kernel row id, never re-minted.

agent_definition_id.description: Existing agent_definition row id for the profile that admitted this session. Identity lives in spawned_from, not label.

anyOf.description: Optional operator-facing label for readability only; never the profile identity.

name: qf_create_task
description: Create an open task with one trusted delegator and one assignee. The Kernel writes delegated_by and assigned_to atomically; callers cannot supply either identity link.

task_id.description: Guest-minted task id — adopted as the Kernel row id, never re-minted.

title.description: Short outcome-oriented title for the task.

description.description: Completion contract a verifier can judge from observable evidence.

assignee_session_id.description: Existing agent_session id that owns execution; written as assigned_to.

name: qf_complete_task
description: Complete an open task with its durable result artifact. The Kernel accepts it only when trusted worker context owns the assignment and the result derives from that worker's Kernel-receipted generated ontology read.

result_artifact_id.description: Canonical result trajectory artifact that proves this task's completion lineage.

name: qf_reassign_task
description: Move an open task to a different running agent_session while preserving its trusted delegator and receipt provenance.

assignee_session_id.description: Different running agent_session that will own the task.

name: qf_cancel_task
description: Cancel an open task without deleting its trusted delegator or assignee provenance links.

name: qf_create_connection
description: Create a typed canvas connection edge (kind data|control|view) between two port refs. It persists projection wiring only through the Kernel command path — never a second truth store or a self-loop.

connection_id.description: Guest-minted connection id — adopted as the Kernel row id, never re-minted.

kind.description: Connection kind. view is inert UI wiring; data and control grant runtime obligations and must not be implied by the renderer alone.

from_ref.description: Source port id as tileId:side (n|e|s|w). Must name a different tile than to_ref.

to_ref.description: Target port id as tileId:side (n|e|s|w). Duplicate from/to/kind triples are rejected.

name: qf_delete_connection
description: Delete a connection row by id and append connection.deleted. Hard delete only — the ontology has no tombstone field, and canvas persistence must never keep the edge.

name: qf_start_agent_session
description: Bring a starting agent session into running (starting → running).

session_id.description: Agent session id (guest-minted; adopted, never minted).

name: qf_block_agent_session
description: Block a running agent session (running → blocked).

name: qf_unblock_agent_session
description: Return a blocked agent session to running (blocked → running).

name: qf_cancel_agent_session
description: Cancel a running or blocked agent session (→ cancelled).

name: qf_fail_agent_session
description: Fail a starting, running, or blocked agent session (→ failed). Used for guest crash and boot reconciliation.

reason.description: Diagnostic label for why the session failed (crash code, stop reason, or boot reconciliation). Optional; recorded in the event payload when supplied and does not affect transition legality.

name: qf_close_agent_session
description: Close a running, cancelled, or failed agent session (→ closed).

name: qf_publish_artifact
description: Publish an immutable content-addressed artifact (must land before sandbox death).

kind.description: Artifact kind to publish.

content_hash.description: Advisory content hash; verified against the computed hash when supplied, and a mismatch is rejected.

path.description: Filesystem path to read artifact bytes from; MCP callers must supply this because bytes cannot cross JSON.

evaluation_id.description: Supporting Evaluation that authorizes a report. Required only when kind is report.

name: qf_record_evaluation
description: Record an independent critic verdict over a succeeded deterministic Run. The Kernel derives metrics from the Run result, binds the admitted critic identity and durable findings, and refuses self-review.

findings.description: Durable critic findings: R15 uses an ordered strict finding array; legacy critics may send text.

artifact_id.description: Exact result Artifact produced by the Run.

rubric.description: Exactly four finite scores: faithfulness, answer_relevancy, context_precision, context_recall.

overall.description: Rejected when supplied; the Kernel derives the arithmetic mean.

source_work.description: Frozen source-work tuple copied from the review Task.

review_task_id.description: Governed review Task id receiving this evaluation.

broker_invocation_id.description: Production runtime broker invocation id for qf_record_evaluation.

name: qf_resolve_hypothesis
description: Resolve an open hypothesis to supported|rejected|inconclusive; evaluation-gated at the Kernel.

evaluation_id.description: Evaluation whose hypothesis lineage and verdict authorize this resolution.
